theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmRaw_comm_all {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (i j : ℕ) :
i ≤ j → jmRaw H i * jmRaw H j = jmRaw H j * jmRaw H i

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmRaw_comm_adjacent {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (i : ℕ) :
jmRaw H i * jmRaw H (i + 1) = jmRaw H (i + 1) * jmRaw H i

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmRaw_comm {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (i k : ℕ) :
jmRaw H i * jmRaw H k = jmRaw H k * jmRaw H i

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.jmRaw_eq_one_add_addJM {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (k : ℕ) :
jmRaw H k = 1 + addJM H (q - q⁻¹) k

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.addJM_comm {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (d : R) (i k : ℕ) :
addJM H d i * addJM H d k = addJM H d k * addJM H d i

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.addJM_comm_of_le {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (d : R) (i m : ℕ) (h : i ≤ m) :
addJM H d i * addJM H d (m + 1) = addJM H d (m + 1) * addJM H d i

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.partialSum_succ {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (d : R) (m : ℕ) :
partialSum H d (m + 1) = partialSum H d m + addJM H d (m + 1)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.comm_addJM_of_comm_sigma {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (d : R) (X : A) (i : ℕ) (hX : ∀ j < i, X * HeckeGenerators.σ q j = HeckeGenerators.σ q j * X) :
X * addJM H d i = addJM H d i * X

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.comm_transp_of_comm_sigma {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (X : A) (l i : ℕ) :
l < i → (∀ j < i, X * HeckeGenerators.σ q j = HeckeGenerators.σ q j * X) → X * transp H l i = transp H l i * X

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_comm_partialSum_ne {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (d : R) (j m : ℕ) (h : j ≠ m) :
HeckeGenerators.σ q j * partialSum H d m = partialSum H d m * HeckeGenerators.σ q j

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_comm_partialSum_above {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (d : R) (j m : ℕ) (h : m < j) :
HeckeGenerators.σ q j * partialSum H d m = partialSum H d m * HeckeGenerators.σ q j

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_comm_partialSum {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (d : R) (j m : ℕ) (h : j < m) :
HeckeGenerators.σ q j * partialSum H d m = partialSum H d m * HeckeGenerators.σ q j

def QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.partialSum {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (d : R) (m : ℕ) :
A

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_comm_addJM_small {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (d : R) (j i : ℕ) (h : i < j) :
HeckeGenerators.σ q j * addJM H d i = addJM H d i * HeckeGenerators.σ q j

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_comm_addJM {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (d : R) (j i : ℕ) (h : j + 1 < i) :
HeckeGenerators.σ q j * addJM H d i = addJM H d i * HeckeGenerators.σ q j

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_comm_transp_below {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (j l : ℕ) (hjl : j + 1 < l) (i : ℕ) :
l < i → HeckeGenerators.σ q j * transp H l i = transp H l i * HeckeGenerators.σ q j

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_comm_transp_disjoint {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (j l : ℕ) (hl : l < j) (i : ℕ) :
j + 1 < i → HeckeGenerators.σ q j * transp H l i = transp H l i * HeckeGenerators.σ q j

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_comm_transp_base {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (j l : ℕ) (hl : l < j) :
HeckeGenerators.σ q j * transp H l (j + 2) = transp H l (j + 2) * HeckeGenerators.σ q j

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_comm_transp_far {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (l i m : ℕ) :
l < i → i < m → HeckeGenerators.σ q m * transp H l i = transp H l i * HeckeGenerators.σ q m

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.sigma_comm_transp_pair {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (j i : ℕ) :
j + 1 < i → HeckeGenerators.σ q j * (transp H j i + transp H (j + 1) i) = (transp H j i + transp H (j + 1) i) * HeckeGenerators.σ q j

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.addJM_eq_transp_sum {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (d : R) (k : ℕ) :
addJM H d k = d • ∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, transp H i k

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.transp_pred {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (k : ℕ) :
transp H k (k + 1) = HeckeGenerators.σ q k

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.transp_succ {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (i k : ℕ) (h : i ≠ k) :
transp H i (k + 1) = HeckeGenerators.σ q k * transp H i k * HeckeGenerators.σ q k

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.transp_self {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (k : ℕ) :
transp H k (k + 1) = HeckeGenerators.σ q k

def QOU.BraidKnot.Hecke.transp {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] {q : R} (H : HeckeGenerators R A q) (i : ℕ) :
ℕ → A
